messages:
maya: FYI canary for falcon-quant-int4 is showing ~5.9% funcall JSON parse failures vs fp16 baseline over last 4h. samples include trailing commas and half-escaped newlines, e.g. {"action":"open","args":[1,2,], \n}
liam: thanks. looks like quant suffix corruption again. can we confirm not a proxy/encoder issue?
sophia: pulled raw outputs from nodes; corruption present pre-proxy. pattern = trailing comma + lone backslash inside strings
oliver: quick mitigation idea: three-stage repair flow: 1) local light-sanitize (strip trailing commas, close simple braces, escape lone backslashes) 2) permissive parse (accept single quotes/unquoted keys) 3) mirror-retry to fp16 shadow if still failing and retry_budget>0
maya: constraints: limit light-sanitize to short outputs (token_count<200) to avoid masking semantic truncation; mirror only when schema_conf>0.65
qa-runner: I'll run AB cohorts: control, light-sanitize only, sanitize+tolerant, full flow. start at 1% traffic per cohort, 24h run with 2k probe prompts
devops-bot: scheduled rollout: funcall_repair_v1 -> groups[control:98, sanitize:1, mixed:1] ETA metrics in ~6h
liam: add telemetry fields parse_cause in {trailing_comma, broken_escape, truncation, other} and post_action in {sanitized, tolerant_parsed, mirror_retried}
sophia: note streaming: assemble final payload then run sanitize; streaming mid-chunk fixes will be misleading
maya: QA checklist: measure true-positive fixes vs false-positive acceptances (cases where sanitized JSON is parsable but semantically wrong), latency p50/p95 impact for repaired requests
qa-runner: kicking off now, will post interim graphs in ~6h to #eng-ml
oliver: code note: implement sanitizer as deterministic regex+stack balancer only. LM-based repairs are opt-in separate path.
